The '''Civilian Service Personnel''' was an organization that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When the Empire occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], they had an office at the garrison in [[Argona]]. [[Nadra Enasteri]] was told to go their to see what her assignment was going to be; she was assigned as a med-tech.
